parameters.name: ReceivedFrames
parameters.description: The number of EAPOL frames of any type that have been received by this Supplicant; {{bibref|802.1x-2004|9.5.2}}, EAPOL frames received.

parameters.name: TransmittedFrames
parameters.description: The number of EAPOL frames of any type that have been transmitted by this Supplicant; {{bibref|802.1x-2004|9.5.2}}, EAPOL frames transmitted.

parameters.name: TransmittedStartFrames
parameters.description: The number of EAPOL Start frames that have been transmitted by this Supplicant; {{bibref|802.1x-2004|9.5.2}}, EAPOL Start frames transmitted.

parameters.name: TransmittedLogoffFrames
parameters.description: The number of EAPOL Logoff frames that have been transmitted by this Supplicant; {{bibref|802.1x-2004|9.5.2}}, EAPOL Logoff frames transmitted.

parameters.name: TransmittedResponseIdFrames
parameters.description: The number of EAP Resp/Id frames that have been transmitted; {{bibref|802.1x-2004|9.5.2}}, EAP Resp/Id frames transmitted.

parameters.name: TransmittedResponseFrames
parameters.description: The number of valid EAP Response frames (other than Resp/Id frames) that have been transmitted by this Supplicant; {{bibref|802.1x-2004|9.5.2}}, EAP Resp frames transmitted.

parameters.name: ReceivedRequestIdFrames
parameters.description: The number of EAP Req/Id frames that have been received by this Supplicant; {{bibref|802.1x-2004|9.5.2}}, EAP Req/Id frames received.

parameters.name: ReceivedRequestFrames
parameters.description: The number of EAP Request frames (other than Rq/Id frames) that have been received by this Supplicant; {{bibref|802.1x-2004|9.5.2}}, EAP Req frames received.

parameters.name: ReceivedInvalidFrames
parameters.description: The number of EAPOL frames that have been received by this Supplicant in which the frame type is not recognized; {{bibref|802.1x-2004|9.5.2}}, EAP Req frames received.

parameters.name: ReceivedLengthErrorFrames
parameters.description: The number of EAPOL frames that have been received by this Supplicant in which the Packet Body Length field is invalid; {{bibref|802.1x-2004|9.5.2}}, EAP length error frames received.

parameters.name: LastFrameVersion
parameters.description: The protocol version number carried in the most recently received EAPOL frame; {{bibref|802.1x-2004|9.5.2}}, Last EAPOL frame version

parameters.name: LastFrameSourceMACAddress
parameters.description: The source MAC address carried in the most recently received EAPOL frame; {{bibref|802.1x-2004|9.5.2}}, Last EAPOL frame source.

parameters.name: SuccessCount
parameters.description: Count of the number of successful authentications from the perspective of this supplicant.

parameters.name: FailureCount
parameters.description: Count of the number of failed authentications from the perspective of this supplicant.

object.description: 802.1x Authentication Supplicant EAP statistics information for this resource.
